_documentation.purpose: Trigger -> action -> review -> output. Re-scans each school on the list every quarter, and raises a human review task only when the readiness score has moved. Nothing is emailed by the workflow.
_documentation.credentials: No credential is stored in this JSON. The SMTP and sheet credentials are referenced by name and live in the n8n credential manager. Inspect this file before importing, as you would any workflow JSON.
_documentation.approval: The 'Await human approval' node is deliberate. The workflow prepares the message; a person sends it.

nodes.name: Re-scan and compare
nodes.notes: Calls the same CLI the desktop app uses, so the results are identical. Writes an evidence file and, when the score moved, a Word report.
